full_judgment: 2. The case of the plaintiffs was to the effect that the land measuring. 32 decimals of C.S. plot No. 1077 in khatian No. 209 of Monza Bania originally belonged to Behari Mistry Behari Lal Majumder who died leaving 2 sons Srenibashi Majumder and Naribashi Majumder who inherited the property in equal shares. By a registered deed of sale dated 23-5-73, Srenibashi sold 3 decimals of land to Mohsin Mona who in his turn by a registered deed of sale dated 23-7-75 sold the said decimals of land to the plaintiffs No. 3 by a registered deed of sale dated 18-12-72. Hari Bashi also sold 4 decimals of land to Sarifa Khatun by a registered sale of deed dated 12.12.72. Sarifa sold it to Abdul Jalil Mia on 31.1.79. Abdul Jalil Mia in his turn sold the same to the plaintiff No. 4 by a sale deed dated 29.2.80. Hari Basi again sold 4 decimals of land by a sale deed dated 12.12.72 to Cheman Nahar Begum and Md. Habibulla who in their turn sold the same to Abdul Khaleque and Md. Nabbo Khan by a sale deed dated 10.9.73 and Abdul Khaleque and Md. Nabbo Khan then sold the said 4 decimals of land to the plaintiff No. 5 by a sale deed dated 26.9.74. Srenibashi sold 3 decimals of land by a sale deed dated 15.6.73 to Md. Shamsul Hoque who then sold it to plaintiff No. 6 by a sale deed dated 9.3.77. Thus the plaintiffs are owners in possession of the suit land measuring 18 decimal out of 32 decimals where they are living with their families by making constructions. Defendant No. 1 as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 585 of 1974 in the 1st Court of Subordinate Judge Dhaka against Md. Hanif and Sk. Abdul Majid for specific performance of Contract. The said suit was transferred to the 5th Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka and was re-numbered as Title Suit No. 3 of 1977. The defendant No. 1 of the present suit obtained an exparte decree in the said title suit fraudulently and collusively beyond the knowledge of the plaintiffs. In Title Execution Case No. 1 of 1978, arising out of the aforesaid Title Suit No. 3 of 1977, a process server of the Court went to the suit property on 14.6.80 to deliver possession to the defendant No, 1 but due to the resistance put by the plaintiffs possession of the suit property could not be delivered to the defendant No. 1. Thereafter the plaintiffs have filed the present suit for declaration noted above.
